notes.title: Exodition - Update #4
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.01 
The fourth Update for Exodition is [b]out now![/b]

List of all the changes:

[h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Level 13[/b] - The urbans. The Place where the Sarath-Guards house and the place where you find new powers! 
[*] [b]New Level 14[/b] - The approach of the great Entrance Hall of Horidian with new Puzzles.
[*] [b]A new Mechanic!![/b] - The Storm-Dash with new Jumping-Dynamics as well as a new possible to interact with Horidians Obstacles. Solve the new Puzzles in your way. 
[*] [b]More story[/b] for you to experiece. Get to know a bit more about Horidian and Edom.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Created a hint for an obstacle at the Floating-Intersection 
[/list]

Please send me all feedback you have. I will troubleshoot [b]every problem[/b] as fast as I can!

Next Update will be in October! New levels , New functions!!

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
The very first big Update for Exodition is out! You can play it right now. 

Here is the list of all the changes: 

[h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Level 8[/b] - First stage of the second third of the Game. Out of the city Bottoms. Keep your head down for the flying cars all around you. 
[*] [b]New Level 9[/b] - THE FLIKIES FACTORY. 'The biggest Flikies Factory of Horidian' Conveyor Belts and Meat Grinders won't make your Factory-Tour easy. 
[*] [b]New Secret Areas[/b] where you can find Statues. I won't tell you too much about those as they are secrets for you to find <3 
[*] [b]Controller Support[/b] - Yes. A lot have asked for it, and with the current system I had to rework a lot of stuff, but now it is there ːsteamhappyː
[*] Options menu redone!
[*] [b]More story[/b] for you to experiece. Get to know a bit more about Horidian. 
[*] Sensitivity Option has been added
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Several Writing-Mistakes throughout the first 7 Levels
[*] Additional Level design in Level 2
[*] Wrong Steam-Requirements Information (4mb instead of 4gb RAM) 
[*] Got rid of short camera-glitches between cutscenes and gameplay
[*] Resolution wont change in options
[*] Options were only available in the Main-Menu. Now also in Ingame-Menu
[*] Issues on Settings-Loading
[*] Play time and Deaths are now shown at the end of the EA-Content
[*] Unachievable Steam-Achievements are temporary removed
[*] Electric Tower-Noises are now affected by the Master-Volume slider
[*] Credits have been refined a bit
[*] Save Name is now always in capitals
[*] Village house with collision issues fixed
[*] Settings can now be closed with ESC as they can be opened with that key
[*] In certain Levels you could see underneath the water. Now it is darkness <3
[*] Skip with G was shown on cutscenes, where you could only fast-forward. Now it is propperly declared
[/list]

Thats about it.. I think there may be a few I missed, but I can say that there may be some more things I havent fixed yet. But this is exactly what this Early Access is for. Please send me all feedback you have, so that I can put it on my todo and work it out asap =) [b]Your feedback count![/b]

I will make a little [b]Discount[/b] soon for the Exo-Fans out there who are unsure to pay 20 BuGs for an Early-Access Game.



For the Next Update on July 1st I would love to add Steam Achievements and there will be new levels with new challenges. 
Stay tuned

notes.title: Exodition Early Access - Out now!!
notes.notes:
!!Exodition just released Early Access!! ːsteamhappyː
Come and show what you got by beating the game up to it's current state. 

---

For all of you who are wondering about how much there is available in the game right now, and how much will be in the final game. Here is an overview of the (Rough) Development Plan. 

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/165922191886647297/1235544865975304264/image.png?ex=6634c253&is=663370d3&hm=983599feab5f5984d8283447127958e5e2cf543dc0c4cef4301c25285f9d43fa&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1145&height=676[/img]

So as you can see. The entire base area is already available. And from now on each month I am planning to add at least 2 new Levels. A lot of them are already pretty far in development and just need more polishing before I can actively add it to the Game. If everything goes according to plan Exodition should release fully around November. 
The cool thing is, that you can always be part of the journey, discovering each new area with all others as well as the nice chance to get your Feedback/Ideas into the Game too. I am excited to hear all new ideas.

---

Anyways I just wanted to add that all of this, what happens atm with Exo means so much to me as it is actually a life goal of mine to Finish Exodition. Releasing the Early Access after all this time is an incredible feeling. 
Let's make this Game super Nice!! <3   
Your help will make a difference.

notes.title: 6 Months later
notes.notes:
Hey guys, 
I noticed that I havent posted anything here for a while. The reason is obviously that the Demo is not recieving any more updates and I usually post news on Twitter,Insta, etc. 
The game is progressing a lot in the meantime. 

6 Months of development are behind the Demo-release and I have quiet much to show to you. Too much for one post to be honest so let's get started with one of my Big Favorites. The [b]LORUS[/b]
These are the evil bosses of 'Horidian' - the city where Exodition takes place in. 
Here are a few beauty-shots I took from [b]'The Economist'[/b] 

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E2gK2MYWYAMRNwG?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]

The Lorus are heavily inspired by one of my Favorite Insects. Mantis! I could watch these magnificent predators all day. Especially when they catch and eat their prey. I thought that they will fit well to the fanatic Species which is leading the city with a brutal autority.

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E2gNvPWWUAA8CW_?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]

I imagine the Game-mechanic on the Lorus similar to the Bosses in Little Nightmares. Sneaking in the right moments right behind the Characters. It was always SO frightening! =D 

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E2gMgUZXMAIr3kf?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]

'The Economist' is part of the high council of the Lorus. The concept of the other members is already done. Check it out guys. 

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E2gBYGfWUAU2RxI?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]
Which one is your favorite?

Until next time I wish you a nice time =))
